vocab.title: Because of Winn-Dixie
vocab.groupsNote: The quiz covers the green words (green cards on the back).

words.sentence: We bought bananas and tomatoes from the produce stand at the farmers market.
words.fill: Mom bought apples, carrots, and lettuce in the ___ section of the grocery store.

words.def: A case where a rule does not apply
words.sentence: Our class has no recess on rainy days, but Friday was an exception because we went to the gym.
words.fill: Everyone has to wear sneakers in gym class. The only ___ is a student with a broken foot.

words.def: When money is paid over a length of time
words.sentence: My aunt is paying for her new laptop in installments of $50 each month.
words.fill: Dad pays for the new couch a little bit every month. Each payment is called an ___.

words.sentence: The peculiar cat liked to sleep in the bathtub instead of its bed.
words.fill: A dog with purple spots would look very ___, because most dogs do not look like that.

words.sentence: The employee at the shoe store helped me find my size.
words.fill: My aunt is an ___ at the bank, and she gets paid every two weeks.

words.def: favored by or involving good luck or fortune
words.sentence: I was fortunate to find my lost lunchbox before lunch time.
words.fill: We were ___ that the rain stopped right before the baseball game.

words.def: lacking knowledge or awareness in general
words.sentence: I was ignorant about how bees make honey until we read about it in science.
words.fill: Before he read the book, my brother was ___ about how sharks live.

words.sentence: The gray, rainy day gave the whole house a melancholy feeling.
words.fill: After her best friend moved away, my sister felt a deep ___ for weeks.

words.sentence: My best friend is trustworthy because he always keeps his promises.
words.fill: My neighbor always does what he says he will do. He is very ___.

words.def: A group of stars in the night sky that make up a picture or a pattern
words.sentence: Grandpa showed me the Big Dipper and other constellations in the night sky.
words.fill: On a clear night, we used a star map to find ___ like Orion.

words.sentence: My little cousin kept tapping the table, and the noise was irritating.
words.fill: My little brother kept poking my arm. It was so ___ that I asked him to stop.

words.def: To prevent something from continuing as usual
words.sentence: The fire drill distracted our class from the spelling lesson.
words.fill: The loud music ___ me, and I could not finish my homework.
